verdict.rationale: Column's docs say you can programmatically open and manage FDIC-insured bank accounts on behalf of customers, including FBO, sweep, clearing and custom account types (column-docs-2, column-docs-17). A community commenter separately describes creating multiple account numbers that point to a single bank account, each with its own permissions and limits, which matches virtual and collection accounts under a master structure (column-comm-7). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the account-number API itself, explicit evidence of issuance at scale, explicit mention of routing numbers, documented sub-account hierarchy and reconciliation workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.
